description: Return the double entry for one payment period or month: debit interest expense and loan liability, credit cash, in the cash book's account names, with an expense_add-ready payload. Give period or month, not both. Pro.

cash_account.description: Credit account for the payment. Default "cash"

category.description: Expense category for the expense_add payload. Default "interest"

interest_account.description: Debit account for the interest. Default "interest_expense"

liability_account.description: Debit account for the principal. Default "loan_liability"

loan.description: The loan id, e.g. LOAN-2026-0001, or its exact name

month.description: Journal every payment falling in this month, YYYY-MM. Give this or period

period.description: The payment period to journal. Give this or month

name: loan_journal
title: Journal a loan payment
